_comment: Roadmap 2 S7: the CC0 boats in assets/boats/boats.glb (Kenney Watercraft Kit 2.1, 'Models/GLB format'). Packed with tools/food-kit/pack-food.js --recipes tools/boat-kit/boats.json --name boats --out assets/boats/boats.glb (palette texture baked into vertex colours, one child mesh per boat named 'name'). size = metres along the longest side (the boat's length). rotY = degrees to turn the bow to +z. data/boats.json → types.<id>.model names the child mesh.
